name: Fluent Bit v5 vs OTel-Collector vs OTel-Arrow — Benchmark Comparison (ISI-1779 B1-v2, timeframe-driven)

0.markdown:
# Fluent Bit v5 vs OTel Collector vs OTel-Arrow — benchmark comparison

**This dashboard is the measurement surface for ISI-1779 (plan rev 5 §5). There are no snapshots — set the timeframe and read the run.**

### How to read a run
1. Open `results/RUN-REGISTER.md` on branch `fluentbit-v5-vs-otel-arrow` and pick a row (`R1-P1-collector` … `R2-P3-arrow`).
2. Paste that row's **Start (UTC)** and **End (UTC)** into the dashboard timeframe picker, verbatim.
3. Every tile below is timeframe-driven and sliced by `k8s.workload.name` / `benchmark.engine`, so the window alone selects the engine and the round. **No tile carries its own `from:` clause** — if you see numbers without setting a timeframe, you are reading the default window, not a run.
4. Compare `R1-P<n>-<engine>` with `R2-P<n>-<engine>` for replication; compare engines *within one round* for the headline.

### What is on the grid
Engine workloads are the three `bench-*` deployments on cluster `observable-otelarrow`: `bench-otel-collector-collector`, `bench-fluentbit-v5`, `bench-otel-arrow-native`. Only one is deployed at a time (plan §1) — **a correctly-scoped window contains exactly one engine workload. If you see two, the window is wrong**, most likely an End timestamp captured after the next phase started.

CPU is in **millicores**, memory in **MiB**.

1.query: timeseries cpu = avg(dt.kubernetes.container.cpu_usage), by:{k8s.workload.name}, filter: k8s.cluster.name == "observable-otelarrow" and startsWith(k8s.workload.name, "bench-")
1.title: CPU per engine (millicores) — timeframe = the run window

10.markdown:
### Caveats that change how these numbers are read

- **Restarts / OOM kills** use `arrayMax`, not `arraySum`. The Dynatrace k8s counters report the container's restart count and are only emitted when non-zero; summing them across intervals double-counts one restart once per sample. The tile is driven off the CPU metric and looks the counters up, so a healthy engine shows an explicit **0** rather than a blank tile you cannot distinguish from a broken query.
- **Ingest volume by signal covers spans and logs.** Those are record-countable in Grail. OTLP **metric datapoints** are not — a metric arrives as a series, not a countable record — so the metrics signal is represented by the *series-arriving-per-engine* tile (liveness and breadth), and datapoint throughput is taken from the engine's own exported-datapoint counter at gate time (`validate-phase.sh` check 5). Do not read the metric-series count as a volume comparison.
- **`app-sdk` vs `istio-mesh`** is split on `benchmark.telemetry_source`, which only the Istio `Telemetry` CR sets. `benchmark.engine` cannot make this split — the engines stamp it on every record they process, app and mesh alike.
- **Scope exclusion D1 (board, 2026-07-22):** Istio/Envoy Prometheus metrics are excluded from every run — no Prometheus receiver, no ServiceMonitor, no Envoy scrape, on any engine, in any phase. App-emitted OTLP metrics **are** in scope and are measured. Istio-generated spans and access logs are in scope.
- **Workload names collide across clusters** on this tenant (`observable-kagent`, `observable-agentsandbox`, `observable-otelarrow` all report `dt.kubernetes.container.*`). Every resource tile is therefore scoped by `k8s.cluster.name == "observable-otelarrow"`. Do not remove that filter.
- Every ratio quoted from this dashboard must state its baseline: **vs OTLP+zstd** is the honest comparison; vs uncompressed is a different, much larger number and must be labelled.

2.query:
timeseries mem = avg(dt.kubernetes.container.memory_working_set), by:{k8s.workload.name}, filter: k8s.cluster.name == "observable-otelarrow" and startsWith(k8s.workload.name, "bench-")
| fieldsAdd mem_mib = mem[] / 1048576
| fields k8s.workload.name, timeframe, interval, mem_mib
2.title: Memory working set per engine (MiB) — slope across the run is the leak signal

3.query:
timeseries { cpu = avg(dt.kubernetes.container.cpu_usage), mem = avg(dt.kubernetes.container.memory_working_set) }, by:{k8s.workload.name}, filter: k8s.cluster.name == "observable-otelarrow" and startsWith(k8s.workload.name, "bench-")
| fieldsAdd cpu_avg_mc = arrayAvg(cpu), cpu_p95_mc = arrayPercentile(cpu, 95), cpu_max_mc = arrayMax(cpu),
            mem_avg_mib = arrayAvg(mem) / 1048576, mem_peak_mib = arrayMax(mem) / 1048576
| fields engine = k8s.workload.name, cpu_avg_mc, cpu_p95_mc, cpu_max_mc, mem_avg_mib, mem_peak_mib
| sort cpu_avg_mc desc
3.title: Resource summary — CPU avg/p95/max (mc) and memory avg/peak (MiB) over the window

4.query:
timeseries cpu = avg(dt.kubernetes.container.cpu_usage), by:{k8s.workload.name}, filter: k8s.cluster.name == "observable-otelarrow" and startsWith(k8s.workload.name, "bench-")
| fields engine = k8s.workload.name
| lookup [ timeseries { r = sum(dt.kubernetes.container.restarts), o = sum(dt.kubernetes.container.oom_kills) }, by:{k8s.workload.name}, filter: k8s.cluster.name == "observable-otelarrow"
           | fieldsAdd restarts = arrayMax(r), oom_kills = arrayMax(o)
           | fields k8s.workload.name, restarts, oom_kills ],
         sourceField: engine, lookupField: k8s.workload.name
| fieldsAdd restarts = coalesce(lookup.restarts, 0), oom_kills = coalesce(lookup.oom_kills, 0)
| fields engine, restarts, oom_kills
| sort engine asc
4.title: Stability — restarts & OOM kills in the window (0 = healthy, blank = no engine in window)

5.query:
fetch spans | filter k8s.cluster.name == "observable-otelarrow" and isNotNull(benchmark.engine) | fieldsAdd signal = "spans"
| summarize records = count(), by:{ engine = benchmark.engine, signal }
| append [ fetch logs | filter k8s.cluster.name == "observable-otelarrow" and isNotNull(benchmark.engine) | fieldsAdd signal = "logs"
           | summarize records = count(), by:{ engine = benchmark.engine, signal } ]
| sort records desc
5.title: Ingest volume by signal — records reaching Dynatrace through the engine

6.title: OTLP metric series arriving per engine (liveness/breadth, NOT a volume comparison)

7.query:
fetch spans | filter k8s.cluster.name == "observable-otelarrow" and isNotNull(benchmark.engine) | fieldsAdd signal = "spans", ts = timestamp
| append [ fetch logs | filter k8s.cluster.name == "observable-otelarrow" and isNotNull(benchmark.engine) | fieldsAdd signal = "logs", ts = timestamp ]
| makeTimeseries records = count(), by:{ benchmark.engine, signal }, interval: 1m, time: ts
7.title: Ingest rate over the run (records/min by signal)

8.query:
fetch spans | filter k8s.cluster.name == "observable-otelarrow" and isNotNull(benchmark.engine)
| fieldsAdd source = if(benchmark.telemetry_source == "istio-mesh", "istio-mesh", else: "app-sdk")
| summarize spans = count(), by:{ engine = benchmark.engine, source }
| sort spans desc
8.title: App SDK vs Istio mesh spans — both must be non-zero for a valid phase (gate checks 2 & 4)

9.query:
fetch spans | filter k8s.cluster.name == "observable-otelarrow" and isNotNull(benchmark.engine)
| fieldsAdd app = coalesce(service.namespace, "unlabelled")
| summarize spans = count(), by:{ engine = benchmark.engine, app }
| sort spans desc
9.title: Spans by app — otel-demo and hipster-shop must BOTH appear (gate check 2)
